title: What If You Fell Into a Black Hole?

scenes.text: What if you fell into a black hole? Which one matters more than you'd think.
A small one would stretch you into a strand of atoms before you got close. Scientists call it spaghettification.
A giant one, millions of times the Sun's mass, is gentler. You'd cross the point of no return without feeling a thing.
From outside, your friends would see you slow down, turn red, and freeze at the edge forever.
From inside, you'd see the whole universe squeezed into a shrinking circle of light above you.
Then the centre, where the laws of physics as we know them simply stop. Nobody knows what happens next.

description:
What if you fell into a black hole?
A small one shreds you; a supermassive one lets you cross the horizon unharmed while friends outside watch you freeze. Inside: the universe shrinks to a dot, then physics stops.
What should we run through next?
